output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-bbc567e4316e] is just a metric name. The section heading it sits under [ev-1f419676f177] supplies the rest: some `cortex_`-prefixed metrics change to the `loki_` prefix in 3.0.0, `cortex_prometheus_rule_group_duration_seconds_sum` is one of the listed metrics, and setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` instead of the default `loki` keeps the old prefix. That covers the change (a rename to `loki_prometheus_rule_group_duration_seconds_sum`), who is exposed (deployments left on the default `metrics_namespace`) and what happens if they do nothing (the metric is no longer emitted under its `cortex_` name). The heading also says `metrics_namespace` is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release, after which the prefix will be `loki`.
